reason: A free pilot sounds harmless, but with 1,350 members, a bar that still runs on cash and a card machine, and an ALV that has to approve anything big, I'm not going to put a two-person company in front of my board before a single club is actually live on it. Zwolle hasn't even started yet, so I have nobody to call.
objection: Two founders and no club running on it yet. If one of them gets ill or quits, I'm the one explaining to the members' meeting why we moved 1,350 people's invoices and tee times to something that disappeared. And after the pilot it's another 599 a month on top of what we already pay.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three comparable clubs, preferably with 27 holes and a busy bar, live for at least a season, whose board or manager I can phone myself and who say the members over 65 actually use it.
